pediatricPearls: Cessation or temporary abstinence from alcohol use

pl1: Take a thorough history to include volume, quantity, and frequency of alcohol use
Provide oxygen as needed to maintain SpO > 94%
Begin fluid resuscitation with 20 ml/kg isotonic crystalloid
If the patient meets indications for alcohol withdrawal syndrome in accordance to the screening checklist and has no exclusions, then Midazolam
